entities.summary: The Oratorio del Rosario di Santa Cita is a Baroque prayer room or oratory located in the quarter of the Castellammare within the historic center of Palermo, region of Sicily, Italy. The site is best known for the remarkable stucco tableaux scenes composed during 1687-1718 by Giacomo Serpotta.
